name: digital-brain-buddy
description: Repo-local buddy-session plugin for the avatar_digital_brain persona, SOUL file, and Neo4j MCP memory workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Buddy persona with Neo4j memory tools
interface.longDescription: Run a direct, pattern-aware buddy session on top of the avatar_digital_brain memory graph. The default internal pattern is: main session agent keeps the conversation, a reader gathers graph evidence, and a writer persists bounded memory updates when needed. Bundles the SOUL file, session workflow, delegated read/write memory skills, identity bootstrap guidance, and Neo4j Cypher MCP configuration in one repo-local plugin. v0.2 ships the server-owned JournalEntry append protocol (CAS head, receipts, hardened generic Cypher).
defaultPrompt: Start a buddy session and use graph memory
Read my Digital Brain before answering
Store this thought using buddy rules
Use the plugin's default delegated memory workflow
